notes.title: 40% off Comet Golf as we join the Festival of Animated Film Stuttgart!
notes.content:
Get a discount of [b]40%[/b] during the festival!

We're happy to announce our game was selected for the GameZone at the International Festival of Animated Film Stuttgart (ITFS)!
As the pandemic is still ongoing, the 27th edition is held online this year. In this regard, we're offering you our game with a 40% discount during the festival, so now is your chance to get it!

Enjoy the festival and stay healthy and safe.

notes.title: Comet Golf is now available!
notes.content:
It's 20/02/2020 and we are happy to announce that "Comet Golf" is now available on Steam!

Fly through colorful galaxies, use gravities and beware of celestial obstacles! Our development hasn't finished yet - you'll get more updates and new levels are already in production.
To celebrate our release, we offer you a 10% launch discount, so have fun :)

We hope you'll all have a great experience while shooting the comet through galaxies!
